attributes.board_name: Utah Board of Pharmacy (Division of Professional Licensing)

rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE-approved providers; nationally recognized health-related CE approval organizations (pharmacy-related); Division trainings; ACPE-accredited association meetings
rules.new_licensee_rule: Hours are reduced proportionately for licensees first licensed during the two-year cycle.
rules.alternatives: Current PTCB or ExCPT certification fulfills the CE requirement (except required vaccine-topic hours). The Division may defer or waive CE under R156-1-308d.
rules.audit_note: Keep proof 4 years after the cycle: NABP CPE Monitor registration plus certificates for CE it cannot track.

topics.who: Technicians who give vaccines: vaccine topics each cycle (not covered by PTCB/ExCPT certification)

rules.notes: 6 of the 20 hours must be live or technology-enabled lectures/seminars/workshops. Technicians who give vaccines need 2 more hours in vaccine topics each cycle.
rules.legal_basis: Utah Admin. Code R156-17b-309(2); renewal date R156-1-308a
